speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: Excellent idea. Artificial reefs can become valuable habitats for fish species, including the endangered Conan Cod.

speaker: AQUANAUTILUS
text: The abundance of fish may also attract species higher up the food chain, such as seals.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: The reefs create new opportunities for us, including oyster and mussel breeding grounds.

speaker: FISHERS GUILD
text: We will need to adapt our fishing techniques, which is expensive and requires training.

speaker: LEGAL ADVISOR
text: Arcadia is not obliged to help the fishers transition, but it is good practice under the just transition principles in the Paris Agreement.
